title: 🎥 Remarks by Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs, on the trilateral meeting between Iran, Russia, and the Republic of Azerbaijan on the sidelines of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) summit.
text:
🎥 Remarks by Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs, on the trilateral meeting between Iran, Russia, and the Republic of Azerbaijan on the sidelines of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) summit."

"🔹The meeting was held at Russia’s initiative, and several joint projects among the three countries were discussed and agreed upon. There are projects that involve economic cooperation among the three countries.
